nextTask.goal: Implement a pure immutable route-agent cursor that preserves stable token identity while consuming simulation time across compiler lane -> safe connector -> outgoing lane stages, without touching Phaser, materialization or visible vehicle movement.
actions: Create a pure route-agent module with no scene/Phaser/materializer dependency.
Represent stable tokenId, routeHop, current stage, current lane, connector/next lane when crossing, previous lane and normalized stage progress.
Advance by elapsed seconds using explicit stage geometry length and a supplied/default speed, consuming leftover time across stage boundaries.
A lane may transition only through preferred compiler transitions; if a required safe connector is missing, stop safely at the lane end instead of inventing geometry.
Preserve token identity and immutable input state across lane -> connector -> lane.
Add focused tests for multi-stage leftover-time consumption, identity preservation, deterministic repeatability, safe no-continuation behaviour and no mutation.
Do not install or call the route cursor from macro traffic or visible traffic yet.
acceptance: tokenId is unchanged across all route stages
elapsed time can cross lane/connector/lane boundaries in one pure advance call
stage progress is bounded and finite
only compiler-owned preferred transitions and activation-safe connectors are consumed
missing continuation/connector produces an explicit blocked result rather than teleport/reversal
doNotAdvanceIf: route cursor needs macro district coordinates
route cursor mutates compiler topology or runtime materializer state
a missing connector is worked around with free-form coordinates
visible traffic is activated before M3/M4 gates
